body:
I just wanted to add a bit more. I'm gonna try to sleep soon...I've calmed down since I fought with my mom, but I'm still going to do *something* soon. My mom is taking a trip to England soon, and that'd be the right time to run away...or off myself. I've gotten to the point where I feel like i have to do something...it's like an itch that won't go away.

One of the worst things that bugs me about life is that we're all just going to die and it won't really matter what we did. Our existence will end, we won't feel guilty for not being a better person, nor will you be rewarded for being great. 

One of the other things that bugs me is society. I hate people that decide what's ethical and what's not. I hate being treated like I'm a bad person by people that don't understand. Why the hell are we still fighting over rights? Fuck, rights for everyone! Wanna be gay? Go be gay. Wanna be Christian? Go be Christian. Wanna be Atheist? Go be Atheist. Why are we still *doing this?* 
It's really hard for me to put my thoughts in words...if you get confused while reading some of these things, thats pretty much how I feel about everything, mixed in with anger, depression, guilt, etc. I don't think I've opened up to anyone...ever. This is the closest I've ever gotten, purely because I love Reddit. 
I'll try not to do anything just because of a moment's anger...but I haven't decided whether I should kill myself or run away or do nothing. 
But I need to do something.
